Plot:
John bails on Kiyoshi's alien-hunting expedition, with Kyoko taking his place. The two decide that aliens gave them the remote so they could investigate the unexplained mysteries of planet Earth. Hijinks ensue.

If you came here looking for fap material... sorry. The K-Files is close to being painfully PG. I'm just as disappointed as you are. Also, there aren't any (meaningful) choices. Sorry, again.

What it does have to offer is one complete story thread. There aren't any forks because I don't want to taunt people with a bunch of dead ends that may never get filled in. Consider this a bottle episode from an alternate ST universe.

Any and all feedback is appreciated, as this scenario is basically me experimenting with and trying to learn about both writing and Ren'py.

title: Spitting Image
description:
Spitting Image


Plot:
After John learns a spell that can change him into anyone he knows, Kat talks him into taking a picture of "Sayaka" and Kiyoshi as a couple. Things go downhill for John from there.

Author Notes:
After K-Files, I thought I'd try something a little more ambitious. Or maybe a lot more ambitious. The goal with Spitting Image is to have a little bit more sexiness and a whole lot more choice than K-Files did. Also a bigger cast and a much less rushed ending.

That said, this is a partial release. The last day is currently a mess, what with the diverging paths, so I decided to cut it off and release the story so far in hopes of soliciting some feedback. Most of the payoff for your choices occurs on the last day so your experience will be fairly linear, though not as linear as K-Files.

As before, any and all feedback is welcome. Tell me what you liked, or better yet tell me what you hated. Tell me what you'd like to see on the last day of the scenario too, if you have any thoughts on that. Or just tell me that I screwed up because it's broken.

Overview

Remote Possibilities is a 'What if' scenario where john does not come into the possession of the remote and it instead falls to some unknown student in the school. But the player still plays as John and now has little to no control over what happens as they instead attempt to figure out who's behind the craziness, or just get swept along for the ride. As time passes and the culprit becomes more brazen and experienced, things will escalate - becoming wilder and darker.

Version 1.2.1:

It's been three years but I've picked this up again. This update adds the continuation of the Cornelia and Sayaka routes, with all routes going equally (with the exception of Rita's due to me not wanting to spoil her character in the main game) now going to the end of the first day, it's around 28500 lines and probably about 4-5 hours long. I also went back and fixed a ton of animation, some janky dialogue, spelling and grammatical errors.

Based on popular demand I've removed the RNG for the new paths.



Future Plans

I'm going to pick this up again at a leisurely pace. Writing a half day at each time. Of course, more routes means exponential growth, so I'm not sure how large I'll make each update. I'll most likely do the "Standard" route first.



Feedback is very much appreciated.

title: The Gift Of Switching
description:
Overview: John and Kiyoshi wake one day to find they've been given an incredible gift: a remote that allows then to switch bodies at will. Instead of keeping it a secret, they immediately let their friends in on the fun. What happens after leads then down many different paths of chaos.


Author's Notes:
Hello all! So I've been working on this off and on for about a year now. I originally wrote the Body Switchers scenario but didn't like there it was going. Giving John and Kiyoshi the power to switch limited my options so I basically started from the ground up and gave them a remote this time (yes, original, I know, but it works!) Some of you will recognize parts from Body Switchers carried over to this one. Some stuff was taken out all together and a whole bunch of new stuff was thrown in. 

It's still very rough around the edges. Some scenes don't have animation and some parts are quick filler I added so I could get a release out for the long Memorial Day weekend  There's only one path that makes it all the way to Day 2. This was my first time really tying several paths together so hopefully it worked out in the end. I'm sure there are a ton of spelling errors than I missed but I got the bulk of them before release.

Thanks and hope you enjoy!

Hello there!

I started to play Student Transfer months ago and the scenario function surprised me a lot: ton of new content at disposal and a solid base game.
I downloaded some scenarios to enjoy myself and my favourite pattern was "The tale of the loser" by Knightmare49.
This scenario completely convinced me to start writing something on my own, so I started

UPDATE 25/07/2021
Uff! We are now at the 0.8 version of this scenario, but it’s nowhere near its completion

It’s been more than two years since I was updating the files and while I was rereading my work a week ago a single thought flashed in my mind: destroy everything
Mainly I tried to correct a little bit the most incomplete point of my work: the textual parts. I don’t think I succeeded, but we’re definitely in a better situation than before. You will also notice that some routes have been updated and/or modified in view of how they will evolve

The most important thing is that I finally decided how to make my stories evolve and I just have to put them in writing. In the next updates I will focus to finish the secondary stories and then finish with the route that will connect' everything (I try to do as little spoilers as possible!). For space issues I had to change some characters with those already 'present in the game (mostly to avoid creating a file too big to handle renpy)

If you want to suggest some ideas about the paths or you catch some bugs, feel free to share in the comments or PM me
I want also to correct the grammar so if you want to help feel free to contact me

When dealing with a demon far beyond his understanding, John stumbles onto a completely non-canon path...
Enter a world that's dangerously close to being likely so far off character that it can barely be considered any kind of canon whatsoever, full of strange ideas that have taken my whimsy.

What is this madness?
Magical Harem DX is my slightly unhinged take on a scenario, and something I started on some time ago before being unable to continue for a variety of boring reasons.
However! I have returned with an update from the previous version I uploaded on this site.
Explore the town, using your home as a central base as you try to fix the wrongs currently plaguing the town and free your friends from tyranny.

Images:
Spoiler: 
The general shape of the scenario is based on one main storyline, with various offshoots and bad endings associated with this, so please do not expect massive branching paths at this time.
I am by no means a great writer, a great storyteller... or a great scripter in Ren'py honestly, so...
Have I sold the scenario enough yet?
In all seriousness, expect some funky off-character writing, a few liberties with plot convenience and some bugs! Please report anything that you feel is broken and I will take a look. I mostly do this for fun, so I'm happy to know people have engaged with it.

Content Warnings:
This scenario currently contains strong language, one bad ending scene that implies violent 'correctional' behaviour against another, at least a couple of lines of British slang, minor voyeurism, some scenes of an explicit nature and the usual ST warnings of mind control, identity death and mild peril.

What is contained in this version?
I had been planning to write a changelog for this version (v0.2.0), but decided that due to a lot of internal changes (and I don't remember everything I have changed) it would be best to use this version as the base moving forward.

Hello everyone, I have been reading some scenarios and routes from the base game, after a while, I have decided to start my own. This is an Identity Death scenario, with the twist that it is written as a romantic comedy.

On this timeline, both Yui and John have started a relationship after dating for a while. One day, they find a remote that falls from the sky, and after trying to prank their family and friends, something goes terribly wrong, forcing them to accept that their lives as they knew them are coming to an end.

Overview
The idea is to explore how the process of Identity Death, treated like a terminal illness, would affect not only the two of them but also their friends and family. This scenario is not complete; currently, I'm uploading only the prologue with the objective of getting feedback on the story, characters, grammar, setting, and anything else you would like to add. Once I gather enough information or feel that I can continue with my current outline for the story, I will work on releasing the complete scenario in the next update.

Scenario Summary: 'After a mysterious class at school, John is abruptly thrown into the body a swim team member. Can he adjust? Will he prosper in his new life?'

About Me
Hello all, this is Guest123 from the Discord. (Yes, I use a "fake" username for both here and the Discord. They're intentionally low effort to poke fun at that fact.)

Ya'll probably don't know much about me, so I thought I'd tell you about why I'm here.

I grew up with a pretty wild dating sim series called Power Pro Kun Pocket. Even with the language barrier, the games always held a special place in my heart. While replaying them recently, I realized I'd really like to create something similar some day. That would be a huge project, however. I just happened to discover that Student Transfer, a game that I've been peeking at from time to time for years, was holding a little game jam. I thought it was great starting point to learn Ren'Py, so I dove right in!

About the Scenario
This scenario is a labor of love that's the result of about a week of hypo-mania fueled writing and several days of programming and patching things up. There's much more planned behind the curtain here (hopefully you'll notice the bread crumbs in this release), but it's been adapted to fit the criteria of the game jam. Stay tuned! Hopefully I'll be able to get the scenario to the initial scope I had in mind eventually.

As for the story itself, it starts as a somewhat standard swap class story besides diverging in a couple key spots. This creates a big existential twist. I've actually story-boarded and wrote a good bit of dialogue for the routes of Yui, Carrie, Katrina, Kyoko, and Sayaka, but for various reasons they didn't make the cut. Flavia and funnily enough Mel were the two I ended up settling on. I felt really good about the Flavia route and Mel's route paired together with it nicely. My interpretations of them also felt the most relatable to my own life. In the end, they were the natural choice.

It's an odd scenario. It's definitely more focused on characters than the transformations even though those do play a prominent part in the plot. I hope ya'll enjoy it! I felt really good about the final product even though there's always room for improvement.

Thanks,
Guest123

Some of the episodes are inspired by other scenarios, some were proposed on the Discord forum, and others are original story concepts.

description:
Long time listener, first time caller.

Costume Swap is a Halloween themed scenario based on the "you become your costume" trope.



After Circe appears at the Tina Koya Halloween party, John must deduce the costumes of his classmates to save the day.
Selecting the correct costume returns somebody back to normal. Selecting an incorrect costume... not so much.
Spoiler: 
This scenario features 26 costume choices, 26 party-goers, and a bit over 26 Halloween themed images. Additionally there are 5 "normal" endings, 5 "special" endings, and around 10 special scenes.
Each character has unique lines for each possible transformation, for over 500 transformation lines (most are short or this would never have been finished).
Reaching an ending will give you hints on how to view more content. When you finish 7 runs all information will be available to see all content.



Estimated reading time is hard to calculate. 30 Minutes for only the endings and special events, as calculated by the game. If you want to see literally every line of dialogue it's probably closer to 2 hours of tedium.

title: Help Me Be Happy
description:
Help Me Be Happy
By JeffCharizardFlame



Plot

A boy with a small amount of social issues, including paranoia and low self-esteem at some points, is in for an experience when his ex-girlfriend is given a strange remote that can alter the world around them. Finding his friends staying with him for the last two weeks of high school due to their parents being away as well, Jeff is thrown into a struggle between satiating his inner desires and lust, while also keeping his grades in check and friendships intact.

News

I plan on switching gears between this and Katalyst, my other scenario, at sometimes infrequent moments. As of right now, though, Happy is my prime directive. I plan on adding more content to it as I go along, but right now I'm using it both as a test of my Ren'Py understanding, as well as a way for me to get used to writing again as after having been a year out of school, you kinda get rusty after a while. At the moment all I have is a couple choices, other than that it's quite linear, but I do hope to do more with it as I start to get more used to scenario writing.

Writer's Note
This scenario was developed using a few characters from the 2.1 release of Student Transfer, so if you get an undefined person error (I forget what the actual context is) make sure you're running Student Transfer version 2.1 or later. The scenario will not be usable otherwise due to these characters not being present.

Install Instructions

Download the .zip file.
Keeping the directory structure, extract the zip to the "game" directory. The only things it should ask you to overwrite are "happy.rpy" and "big crash.ogg", which are okay to do so.
Delete the happy.rpyc file (if you have one) to clean the cache and update the scenario in-game.
Since I'm updating the game via GDrive (that way I can keep old versions documented, at the very least), you will want to delete your cache for the scenario to avoid any issues in the future.

Changelog (by update release date)

Initial Release - 5/30/2017
The initial teaser for the scenario. Only contained up to the swap with Tess.

Version 1.0.4 - 6/15/2017
Update 4. New scenes! Slight change to storyline to flow better, new animations for some scenes, and elaboration on certain details regarding Jeff/Jess's mental issues.

Version 1.0.5 - 8/21/2017
Update 5. Large increase to the size of the scenario, due to new scenes and more animations. Also, some scenes were rewritten slightly to work better with the new idea I have planned as a sub-branch of the Jess path.

title: Greener grasses
description:
Greener grasses


Plot
A what if... scenario for the main game. Basically it's a story in which John find an excuse so he doesn't have to go with Kiyoshi. Katrina goes in his stead and gets the remote as a gift from the aliens.

What makes this scenario special (at least in my opinon) is that the main character is female and all the bodyswaps are Female to Female (At least I expect them all to be, but there might be some token M2F)

Some trivia
Now you may be asking, why the hell would someone make an F2F focused scenario? Believe it or not but there is a minority of people who actually enjoy F2F. And even if you don't enjoy F2F, you should at least give it a shot. Instead of being all about swapping, I put a lot of effort into characterisation and story. Although my writing is nothing compared to writers of other scenarios that have recently been created, I tried my absolute best as someone who has no previous writing experience. You may be also asking why is Kat a bit different from the main game. Reason for that is I tried exploring Kat more in depth and hell, the game never shows us what kat REALLY is like. From my experience people who are all fun and games and tease others are often people who have lot of problems themselves but are trying to hide it. Not to mention it adds more depth than just ''Banter lulz''. But then again this is all just a scenario and is not canon in any way so don't take it too seriously.
I work on this scenario completely alone and it's not finished yet. I am posting it to get some feedback , and to see if there is any interest in this kind of thing and if I should even continue updating it. So all feedback is welcome
In the future I would like to expand some of the scenes (especially the first few minutes of the scenario are kinda shaggy), put more animations in, maybe put in more music and of course add more routes.
